question: Property book karne ke liye kitni advance chahiye hoti hai?
answer: Booking ke liye aam tor par 10% se 30% advance required hoti hai, property aur payment plan ke mutabiq. Exact percentage property listing mein mention hota hai.

question: Property buy karne ke liye kaunse documents chahiye?
answer: CNIC copy, proof of income ya bank statement, aur agar joint ownership hai to dono parties ke CNIC copies chahiye hoti hain. NOC transfer ke waqt developer se lena hota hai.

question: Rent par property lene ke liye security deposit kitna hota hai?
answer: Zyada tar properties par 1 se 2 mahine ka rent security deposit ke tor par liya jata hai, jo contract khatam hone par refundable hota hai (subject to condition of property).

question: Kya property ka title clear hona verify kiya jata hai?
answer: Ji haan, har listing se pehle humari legal team property ke documents, registry, aur NOC verify karti hai taake buyer ko koi legal risk na ho.

question: Investment ke liye kaunsi area best hai?
answer: Currently DHA aur Bahria Town societies mein strong appreciation trend dekha ja raha hai, khaas taur par under-construction commercial plots jo possession se pehle acha ROI dete hain.

question: Property visit schedule karna kitna aasan hai?
answer: Aap hamare agent se call ya WhatsApp par time confirm kar sakte hain, aur hum aapki convenience ke mutabiq site visit arrange kar dete hain, usually next available slot 24-48 hours mein milta hai.

question: Kya installment plans available hain?
answer: Ji haan, kuch under-construction aur investment properties par easy installment plans available hain jisme advance ke baad monthly ya quarterly installments hoti hain, possession completion par milti hai.

question: Agar booking cancel karni ho to kya process hai?
answer: Booking cancellation ki policy developer ke terms par depend karti hai — kuch cases mein advance ka ek hissa refundable hota hai, kuch mein processing fee deduct hoti hai. Exact terms booking agreement mein likhe hote hain.

question: Kya price negotiate ho sakti hai?
answer: Kai listings 'negotiable' marked hain — un par reasonable offer discuss kiya ja sakta hai. Fixed-price listings par negotiation ka margin kam hota hai.

question: Ready possession aur under-construction mein kya farq hai?
answer: Ready possession properties turant handover ho sakti hain, jabke under-construction properties ka possession ek committed timeline (jaise 24-36 months) ke baad milta hai, aam tor par lower price par.
